import requests

# Create a reusable session object
session = requests.Session()

# Attach the Authorization header to all requests made with this session
session.headers.update({"Authorization": "Bearer TESTTOKEN"})

# Make a request using the session
response = session.get("https://api.example.com/me")

# Display the result
print(f"Status Code: {response.status_code}")
print(f"Response Headers: {response.headers}")
print(f"Response Body: {response.text}")
